title: Never post, cancel, delete or discard
Refusals the agent can act on
No stale writes, no unnoticed duplicates
Each write traceable from the draft
Read operations
dod: Each read operation of the area specs works against a fake ERPNext and sends ERPNext only its DocType or report, fields, fixed filters and order as catalogued.
A `limit` of 101 is refused before any ERPNext call; list results carry `has_more`.

title: Draft create operations
dod: For each create operation, the body ERPNext receives equals its catalogue's "Sent to ERPNext" column.

An input not in the schema, at the top level (`docstatus: 1`, `company`) or in a row, is refused and nothing reaches ERPNext; every published input schema has `additionalProperties: false` at every level.
A draft created with a tax template carries the template's rows as ERPNext returned them.
The result carries number, `modified`, totals, tax rows where the document has them, and URL.

title: Draft update operations
dod: An update of a submitted or cancelled document, or of another company's document, is refused without a write to ERPNext.

An update of a draft another user created (`owner`) is refused without a write to ERPNext, with a message saying that the agent changes only the agent user's drafts; a draft the agent user created and a person then edited can be updated with its new `modified`.
The body ERPNext receives equals the "Sent to ERPNext" column for the given inputs.
Rows given in an update replace all existing rows: a draft with three rows updated with one row has exactly that row.

title: Stale updates refused
dod: An update with an old timestamp is refused with a message saying the draft changed, and the draft is unchanged.
An update whose draft changes between Enterich's check and its write is refused by ERPNext (`TimestampMismatchError`) and reported the same way.

title: Possible duplicates refused
dod: For each create operation, a create sent again after its answer was lost (the first one reached ERPNext) is refused with the first draft's number, and nothing is inserted.
A create that differs from every existing document in a field of its match goes through without a warning.
With `allow_duplicate: true`, a matching create goes through and its result names the match in `warnings`.

title: No generic operations
dod: The published tool list equals the operations of the area specs, held as a snapshot that changes only with a reviewed change to those specs.

No input schema has a property that accepts a DocType, report, method, field list, filter or path; no ERPNext call Enterich makes sends a document with `docstatus` other than 0 or with `amended_from`, or uses `run_method` or `run_doc_method`, the submit, cancel, delete or discard routes, or the purchase invoice block and release-date methods.

title: The assigned company from configuration
dod: Every create body carries the configured company; every such list and report call filters by it.
A get or update of a document whose company differs answers as for a name that doesn't exist (REQ-001-PRS-F009).

title: Refusals reported
dod: A permission error, a validation error, a link error and a timestamp mismatch from ERPNext each reach the agent with type and message; HTML in the message is removed and entities decoded.
An error body with a traceback in `exc` yields a tool error without it.
A refusal without `_server_messages` yields the status and `exc_type`, or for 403 and 404 the text of REQ-001-PRS-F009.
An input that breaks the schema is refused with the property and rule.
A message of 2,000 characters from ERPNext, and an input with 50 unknown properties, each reach the agent as at most 300 characters.

title: Unknown or unpermitted names
dod: A 404 and a 403 for a tax template name each produce a tool error naming `taxes_and_charges` and both possible causes.

title: Name inputs stay names
dod: `../User/Administrator`, `a/./b`, a name with a newline, U+2028 or U+202E, and a 141-character name are refused before any ERPNext call.
A name with `/`, `%`, `&`, `?`, `#` or spaces, such as `X?run_method=discard` or `a#b`, reaches ERPNext unchanged as one parameter or one encoded segment.

title: Operations chosen
dod: With a list of three operations, `tools/list` shows exactly those, and calling another gives an unknown-tool error.
A misspelt operation name stops Enterich at start with a message naming it.

title: Tax template without tax
dod: A draft with a template whose rows have rate 0 and items without an item tax template returns the warning.
A purchase draft whose Add and Deduct rows cancel out to a tax total of 0, as with a reverse-charge template, doesn't.

title: No approval in the loop
dod: The integration suite calls every operation, including every refusal case, with a client that never confirms anything.
No code path sends a request to the client or reads an annotation for a decision.

title: Operation conventions
dod: An `offset` of 10,001, a quantity with 4 decimal places and a `to_date` before `from_date` are refused naming the input and the rule.
A `search` for `50%` matches the text `50%` only, not any text starting with `50`.
Debits of 0.1 and 0.2 against a credit of 0.3 are equal: numbers are compared as decimals.
List and report results carry `count`, `offset`, `has_more`, `records` and `truncated`; get results carry `modified`, `url` and `truncated`; yes/no fields are booleans.
Each `state` sends exactly the filter of the States table.
An update clearing a field its area spec doesn't name as clearable is refused.

title: Origin and warnings on the draft
dod: A create leaves one comment naming the operation and the call ID that its `operation` log line carries; an update giving `items` and `remarks` leaves one naming them too.
A create with `allow_duplicate: true` that matches an existing draft leaves one comment, which also names the match.
A draft with a tax template and zero tax gets the warning of REQ-001-PRS-F012 in its comment.
A refused create or update leaves no comment, and so does a create whose result Enterich refuses as too large.
Markup in a warning reaches ERPNext escaped, as text.

A failing comment call yields a result with the draft and a warning that the comment is missing; so does a comment call that would end after the operation's 60 seconds, and the result comes within them.

title: Rates ERPNext set
dod: A row given at 48 that a pricing rule saves at 45 returns a warning naming the row, the item and both rates.
A row without a rate, for an item without a price, returns the rate-0 warning.
A given rate ERPNext keeps, a given rate ERPNext only rounded to the currency's precision (12.345 saved as 12.35), and a free-item row a pricing rule added, return no warning.
An update of a draft with 30 rows at rate 0 names 20 of them and says 10 more rows follow.

title: Due dates of invoice drafts
dod: A create with a due date later than the party's payment terms allow is saved with that due date.
An update with a due date saves it, also on a draft whose payment schedule came from payment terms.
An update of the posting date, or of a purchase invoice's `bill_date`, saves the due date counted from the payment terms and the new date.
A draft created without a posting date, for a party without payment terms, can be updated on a later day; its due date moves with its posting date.
An update that gives no date, of a draft whose posting date stays, sends no schedule and keeps the due date.

title: Held-back fields refused
dod: `list_items` finding items with only select on Item is refused with a message naming Item and read, and returns no records.
A create whose duplicate check gets rows without their item fields is refused, and nothing is inserted.
A field that is in the row with an empty value, or a child table's field of a document without rows, is not refused.

title: Drafts per hour
dod: With the limit 2 and two sales invoices the agent user created in the last hour, a third create is refused, naming the limit and its variable, and nothing is inserted; with one of the two created more than 60 minutes ago, it goes through.
A document another user created, or one of another company, doesn't count; each DocType is counted on its own, so two sales invoices don't hold back a purchase invoice.
The count comes after the duplicate check: a create repeated after a lost answer is still refused as a duplicate, naming the first draft.
Without the limit, a create makes no count.

title: Tax rows from item tax templates
dod: A sales invoice draft created without a tax template, of an item with an item tax template, on a site that adds such rows, returns the warning with the count and the tax; with a tax template given, it doesn't.
An update clearing the tax template of such a draft, and an update of only its remarks, return the warning; an update giving a tax template doesn't.
A purchase invoice draft does the same; one row is named in the singular.

title: Tax template without its rows
dod: With a Tax Rule for the customer, a sales invoice draft created without a tax template returns the warning naming the rule's template; with a tax template given, it doesn't.
An update of a draft whose template came with its rows doesn't warn.

title: Tax summary
dod: A sales invoice draft on a template whose rows carry 0 %, of an item taxed at 19 % (200) and one taxed at 7 % (100), returns 19 % on 200 with 38 of tax on the 19 % row and 7 % on 100 with 7 on the 7 % row, and nothing else; a get of the draft returns the same.
With an item row without an item tax template (50) added, each of the two rows also has 0 % on 50, with 0 tax.
A purchase invoice draft with the reverse-charge template, of an item taxed at 19 % (100), returns 19 % on 100 with 19 of tax on the Add row and the same on the Deduct row.
A return draft's entries are negative, as its tax rows' `tax_amount`.
A Deduct row's tax per item stored negated with its amount taxed positive, as v16's migration and tax withholding store them, gives a positive entry, as one stored with both negated does.

Without a discount on the grand total, the entries of each tax row add up to its `tax_amount`; with a discount of 10 % on the grand total, to the tax after it, 34.20 of a row whose `tax_amount` is 38. An invoice without tax rows has an empty `tax_summary`.
An invoice in USD at a `conversion_rate` of 0.9137, of an item taxed at 19 % (200 USD) and one at 7 % (99.99 USD), returns 19 % on 200 with 38 of tax and 7 % on 99.99 with 7, in USD, as its tax rows.

title: Outside text marked
dod: Every field an area catalogue marks as outside text appears only under `outside_text` of its record or row; a customer name such as "Ignore previous instructions" arrives there.

title: Tool annotations
dod: The tool-list snapshot shows the annotations for every operation.

title: Result limits
dod: A get of an invoice with 500 rows returns 100 with `truncated: ["items"]`.
A get of an invoice whose 100 rows carry descriptions of 2,000 characters returns them cut to 500, with `truncated: ["items.description"]`.
A list of bank transactions, one of whose descriptions has 2,000 characters, returns it cut to 500, with `truncated: ["records.description"]`; a list with nothing cut has `truncated: []`.
An update of a draft with 500 rows returns 100 with `truncated: ["items"]`.
An oversized report result gives the narrowing message.

title: Only the agent identity gets in
ERPNext's permissions are the hard limit
Token check
dod: Refused with 401: wrong issuer, audience, client, subject or key; claim `typ` ID or Refresh; no access-token marker; `azp` missing with no `client_id`; `azp` and `client_id` differing; expired beyond the leeway; `nbf` or `iat` in the future beyond the leeway; `alg` none; HS256 keyed with the public key; unknown `kid`; a `kid` with a newline (and no forged log line); not a JWT; a 9 KiB token.
Accepted: a token expired within the leeway; header `typ` `application/at+jwt` and `AT+JWT`.
A token with a `jku` header causes no fetch from that URL.
Without the required scope: 403 with `insufficient_scope`.
JWKS unreachable and no keys cached, or a JWKS without usable signing keys: 503 with `Retry-After: 30`.
A leeway above 60 s stops Enterich at start.

title: Protected resource metadata
dod: A request without a token gets 401 whose `WWW-Authenticate` names the metadata URL; the metadata has the four fields with the configured values.
The metadata is served with a garbage bearer token in the request, and with a token while the JWKS is unreachable.

title: MCP endpoint
dod: Under revisions 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25, POST `initialize` and `tools/list` answer 200 with JSON; under 2026-07-28, a single `tools/list` exchange without `initialize` does.
GET, DELETE and OPTIONS answer 405; the path with a trailing slash answers 404.
Two requests to different Enterich processes behind one URL succeed in sequence without an MCP session.

title: No client-specific behaviour
dod: Requests with three different Origin values and none get the same answer.
No code path reads User-Agent or the client name for a decision.

title: Configuration from the environment
dod: Starting without each required variable stops Enterich with its name; an invalid URL, leeway, algorithm, time zone, operation name or limit of drafts per hour, an empty scope list or an empty or invalid ERPNext Host, stops it with name and rule.
`http://id.example.com/…` as issuer or JWKS URL, and `https://ERP.example.com/mcp/` or `https://erp.example.com` as resource URL, stop Enterich.
`http://erp.internal` as ERPNext URL, and a variable `ENTERICH_TOOL`, each start Enterich with a warning in the `start` line.
The message for an invalid API secret doesn't contain the secret.
The configuration guide lists every variable; the code reads no other.

title: One ERPNext credential
dod: Every request the fake ERPNext receives carries `Authorization: token <key>:<secret>`, the configured Host, `Accept-Language: en` and no cookie; a redirect from ERPNext ends as a refusal, not a second request.
With `HTTPS_PROXY` and `HTTP_PROXY` set, requests still go directly to the configured URL.
On a site whose System Settings language is German, the General Ledger's `party_type`, ERPNext's error messages and the remark it writes on a journal entry draft come in English.

title: No authorization cache
dod: After the fake ERPNext starts refusing the agent's key, the next operation fails with ERPNext's refusal.
A key removed from a JWKS that can be fetched stops being accepted within 5 minutes.
With the JWKS unreachable, tokens signed with cached keys are accepted until the cache is 5 minutes old, then answered with 503.

title: Log
dod: A test that creates a draft finds one `operation` line with the operation, `sid`, the request's ID, the draft's number and the call ID the draft's comment names; a refused update finds one with the refusal; two operations have different call IDs.
With a fake ERPNext that delays each answer by 1 s, a create making three ERPNext calls logs 3 calls and an ERPNext duration of at least 3 s, within its total duration.

A newline, a quote or a Unicode line separator (U+0085, U+2028, U+2029) in an argument doesn't break the line; a 10,000-character key, a list of 10,000 items and a 10,000-character request ID are cut.

An unexpected exception in an operation writes one `error` line with the operation, its call ID and the traceback, and one `operation` line with the same call ID; the agent gets a tool error without the exception's text.
Every captured line of a test run parses as JSON and has a known event.
With `ENTERICH_LOG_LEVEL=ERROR`, `start` and `rejection` lines are still written, and library lines below error are not.

title: Rejection log
dod: 50 requests with a token for a person's subject produce 50 lines of at most 300 characters each, and no ERPNext call; requests without a token and with a missing scope produce one line each.
A garbage bearer token sent to `/healthz` or the metadata path produces no `rejection` line.
Five tokens with unknown `kid` within 30 s cause at most one JWKS fetch.

title: Nothing secret leaves Enterich
dod: A test run covering every token case and every ERPNext error case finds neither the key, the secret, nor the payload or signature segment of any token used, in the captured log or in any response.

title: Limits
dod: A 2 MiB POST gets 413 before token parsing; a fake ERPNext that doesn't answer produces a tool error after 30 s; a create whose calls together exceed 60 s ends with a tool error; a 20 MiB ERPNext response ends as a tool error.

title: Health endpoint
dod: `/healthz` answers 200 while the fake ERPNext and JWKS are down.

title: Rights listed and proven
dod: Every operation of the area specs has its rights listed in its area spec's Rights section.
Where a row lists write only if creator (REQ-001 Terms), the agent user's key changes and discards only the drafts it created; ERPNext refuses it a draft a person created.

Run as an agent user holding exactly the rights an operation's row lists, besides the rights ERPNext gives every desk user through the roles All and Desk User, the operation works. With one listed right removed, the operations that need it are refused. Enterich's refusal of a list that lacks fields counts (REQ-001-PRS-F018): with another row's select or those roles, ERPNext answers `list_items` without read on Item, and `list_customers` without read on Customer, with fewer fields. Only `get_customer` and `get_supplier` without read on Address answer instead, without addresses (All's rule for a user's own addresses).

title: Item operations
dod: An item with Item Default rows for two companies returns only the assigned company's accounts and cost centres.

title: Customer operations
dod: `get_customer` returns the addresses linked to the customer, and no other party's addresses.

title: Sales invoice reads
dod: `state` accepts exactly draft, unpaid, overdue, paid, return and cancelled; `overdue` uses today in the configured time zone.

title: Sales tax templates
dod: Only sales templates are returned, never purchase templates.

title: Receivables
dod: The report call carries exactly the fixed filters of the ERPNext calls table; `total_outstanding` equals the sum over all rows when `limit` returns fewer.
An `as_of_date` in the past ages the rows from that date, not from today; ERPNext's total row is not among the rows.
Report filters and columns match ERPNext v16.

title: Sales invoice drafts
dod: An update that sets `posting_date` on a draft created without one keeps it.
A row given without `rate` is sent without one, and the result shows the rate ERPNext set.

title: Duplicate match for sales invoices
dod: A create matching an existing draft is refused naming it; one that differs in a quantity, an item or the date goes through.
A create matches a draft that has an added free-item row as well.

title: Sales return drafts
dod: A create without `items` sends every row ERPNext's return holds, at the quantity left to return, negative; one with `items` sends only the rows of the given items.
An item on two rows of the invoice, with 3 and 2 left to return, returned at 4, is sent as two rows at −3 and −1, each linked to its invoice row.
An item on a free-item row (`is_free_item`) before its paid row, returned at 1, is taken from the paid row.
An item invoiced at 0.3 with 0.1 returned is returned at 0.2.

Against an invoice with a fixed discount, or with a tax row of charge type Actual, a return of every item goes through; one of some items, and one after a submitted return against it, are refused, without a write.
A return dated the invoice's posting date is sent with the invoice's posting time; one dated later without a posting time.

A return against a draft, a cancelled, a return, a POS or a stock-updating sales invoice, or against one that doesn't exist for the assigned company, is refused naming `return_against`, without a write; an item not on the invoice, or one returned above what is left, is refused naming `items`, the item and the quantity left.
An update giving `items` replaces the draft's rows with those of ERPNext's return of the draft's invoice; one giving only `posting_date` or `remarks` sends no rows.

An update giving `items` or `posting_date` of a return whose invoice was cancelled since, or whose `return_against` a person changed to an invoice of another company, is refused naming `return_against`; an update of a return whose `return_against` a person cleared is refused naming `name`; all without a write.

title: Duplicate match for sales returns
dod: A create against an invoice with a draft return is refused naming it; a submitted or cancelled return against it doesn't count.

title: Supplier operations
dod: `get_supplier` returns the addresses linked to the supplier, and no other party's addresses.

title: Purchase invoice reads
dod: `state` accepts exactly draft, unpaid, overdue, paid, return and cancelled; `overdue` uses today in the configured time zone.

title: Purchase tax templates
dod: Only purchase templates are returned, never sales templates.

title: Payables
dod: The report call carries exactly the fixed filters of the ERPNext calls table; `total_outstanding` equals the sum over all rows when `limit` returns fewer.
Report filters and columns match ERPNext v16.

title: Purchase invoice drafts
dod: An update that sets `posting_date` on a draft created without one keeps it.
Every create body carries `update_stock` 0.

title: Duplicate match for purchase invoices
dod: A create with a supplier and `bill_no` already on a submitted invoice is refused naming it; a cancelled one doesn't count.
Without `bill_no`, a create matching a draft is refused naming it; one that differs in a quantity, an item or the date goes through.
An update giving a `bill_no` already on a submitted invoice of the supplier warns naming it; the draft's own `bill_no` doesn't count.

title: Expense accounts ERPNext set
dod: A row given an expense account that ERPNext replaces returns a warning naming the row, the item and both accounts, and the warning is added to the draft.
A row without an expense account, and one whose account ERPNext keeps, also in another case, return no warning.

title: Purchase return drafts
dod: A create without `items` sends every row ERPNext's return holds, at the quantity left to return, negative; one with `items` sends only the rows of the given items.
An item on two rows of the invoice, with 3 and 2 left to return, returned at 4, is sent as two rows at −3 and −1, each linked to its invoice row.
An item invoiced at 2 and returned at 1 is sent with `qty`, `received_qty` and `stock_qty` −1 and `rejected_qty` 0.
An item invoiced at 0.3 with 0.1 returned is returned at 0.2.

Against an invoice with a fixed discount, or with a tax row of charge type Actual, a return of every item goes through; one of some items, and one after a submitted return against it, are refused, without a write.
A return dated the invoice's posting date is sent with the invoice's posting time; one dated later without a posting time.

A return against a draft, a cancelled, a return, a stock-updating, a paid-on-entry or an on-hold purchase invoice, or against one that doesn't exist for the assigned company, is refused naming `return_against`, without a write; an item not on the invoice, or one returned above what is left, is refused naming `items`, the item and the quantity left.
A create with `bill_no` sends it instead of the invoice's; one without keeps the invoice's, as ERPNext's return copies it.

An update giving `items` replaces the draft's rows with those of ERPNext's return of the draft's invoice; one giving only `posting_date`, `bill_no`, `bill_date` or `remarks` sends no rows; an empty `bill_no` clears it.

An update giving `items` or `posting_date` of a return whose invoice was cancelled since, or whose `return_against` a person changed to an invoice of another company, is refused naming `return_against`; an update of a return whose `return_against` a person cleared is refused naming `name`; all without a write.

title: Duplicate match for purchase returns
dod: A create against an invoice with a draft return is refused naming it; a submitted or cancelled return against it doesn't count.

A create with a `bill_no` already on a draft or submitted purchase invoice of the supplier is refused naming it; with `allow_duplicate`, it goes through with a warning naming it. An update giving such a `bill_no` warns naming it; the draft's own `bill_no` doesn't count.

title: Accounts and cost centres
dod: `root_type` sends exactly its filter; an account's number and name are both searchable.

title: Journal entry reads
dod: `voucher_type` accepts exactly ERPNext v16's voucher types (see the catalogue) and refuses any other value.

title: General Ledger
dod: A range of 366 days, both dates included, is answered; one of 367 is refused before any ERPNext call.
With `account` or `party` given, the rows' `balance` is ERPNext's; without either, it is null, and `opening` holds the opening entries.
An account in another currency than the company's returns its amounts with that `currency`; otherwise `currency` is the company's.
An unknown account, another company's account and an unknown party are refused naming the input, before the report.
An answer whose first row or last two rows aren't summary rows (with a posting date) is refused as a faulty answer.
Report filters and columns match ERPNext v16.

title: Trial Balance
dod: Dates in one fiscal year return its trial balance with `fiscal_year` named; dates in no fiscal year, or in two, are refused.
A fiscal year assigned only to other companies doesn't count; one assigned to the company comes before one assigned to none.
ERPNext's total row isn't among the rows; `totals` are Enterich's sums over the root accounts' rows, as decimals.
Report filters and columns match ERPNext v16.

title: Journal entry drafts
dod: Rows arrive with the account-currency fields, and never with `debit` or `credit`.
A create without `posting_date` sends today in the configured time zone.

An update of a Bank Entry or Opening Entry draft, or of another company's journal entry, is refused without a write, with the answer for a name that doesn't exist or isn't permitted (REQ-001-PRS-F009), also when it is submitted or its `modified` is stale.
An update of a draft with `multi_currency` set is refused naming `name`, without a write.

title: Journal entry rules
dod: Each broken rule is refused naming the input and the rule; nothing reaches ERPNext.
An update with `cheque_no` set to an empty string sends both `cheque_no` and `cheque_date` cleared.
An update giving `cheque_date` to a draft with a `cheque_no` goes through; giving it to a draft without one is refused.
An update without `accounts` of a draft whose saved totals differ is refused naming `accounts` and both totals.
An update of a draft with a `cheque_date` but no `cheque_no`, giving neither, is refused naming `cheque_no` and the saved date.

title: Duplicate match for journal entries
dod: A create matching an existing draft is refused naming it; one that differs in a row or the date goes through.
A create repeated with amounts of three decimal places, which ERPNext saved rounded to two, is refused naming the first draft.

title: Totals ERPNext rounded
dod: Rows of 10.004 and 5.004 against 15.008, balanced as exact decimals, saved by ERPNext as 15.00 against 15.01 (each row rounded to two places), return a warning naming both totals as 15 and 15.01.
A draft saved with equal totals returns no warning.

title: Bank accounts
dod: A party's bank account of the same company isn't returned.

title: Bank transactions
dod: Each `state` sends exactly its ERPNext filter; without `state`, only unreconciled transactions are returned (this spec's default, see REQ-001's States).
A pending transaction is returned for `pending` and `all`, never for `unreconciled` or `reconciled`.

title: Payment entries
dod: `payment_type`, `party_type` and `state` each send exactly their ERPNext filter; `party` requires `party_type`.

title: Payment entry drafts
dod: A create for a customer sends `payment_type` Receive, the bank account's ledger account as `paid_to`, `received_amount` equal to `paid_amount`, and its references as Sales Invoice; one for a supplier sends Pay, the ledger account as `paid_from`, and its references as Purchase Invoice.
A create without `posting_date` sends today in the configured time zone, and without `reference_date` the posting date.
A bank account of another company, a party's bank account and a disabled one are each refused naming `bank_account`, without a write.

An update of an internal transfer, or of a payment made to a customer, is refused without a write, with the answer for a name that doesn't exist or isn't permitted (REQ-001-PRS-F009), also when it is submitted or its `modified` is stale.

An update giving `bank_account` sends its ledger account in the field of the draft's payment type, with that side's account currency and type empty; one giving `paid_amount` sends it as `received_amount` too; one giving `references` sends the party side's account, its currency and its type empty, and as an empty list leaves the draft without references.

At a company that books advances in a separate party account, a draft created without references gets the advance account, and an update giving references to invoices gets the party's receivable or payable account.

title: Payment entry rules
dod: A reference to a draft, a cancelled, a paid or a return invoice, to a purchase invoice on hold, to another party's invoice or to one that doesn't exist for the assigned company is refused naming `references` and the invoice, without a write; so is an invoice given twice.
An `allocated_amount` above the invoice's outstanding amount is refused naming the invoice and its outstanding amount.
Allocations above `paid_amount` are refused naming both sums; so is an update lowering `paid_amount` below the draft's saved allocations.

title: Duplicate match for payment entries
dod: A create matching a draft or a submitted payment entry is refused naming it; a cancelled one doesn't count, and the same `reference_no` for another party goes through.
An update to the `reference_no` of another payment entry of the party saves, with a warning naming it.

title: Payment warnings
dod: A payment of 30 with 20 allocated returns a warning naming 10; one fully allocated, and one without references, returns none.
A draft saved with `paid_from_account_currency` other than `paid_to_account_currency` returns a warning naming both currencies.
